archetypes.name: final-report-wiring
archetypes.rationale: Final report call sites must preserve compact summaries while appending redacted review detail.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the /design and /implement final report wiring. Focus on whether detail is appended after the compact run-summary marker, whether failures stay best-effort, and whether public comment paths receive the same redacted body. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: round-root-regression
archetypes.rationale: The implement helper must prefer committed run-log roots over stale live round metadata.
archetypes.prompt_body: Check the implement rounds-root selection and tests for the #3794 path mismatch. Verify that an existing run-log directory with no completed rounds still renders the no-rounds message instead of falling back to live tmpdir round metadata. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
